title: private-deployment-orion-weekly-sync-2026-08-10
content:
Orion private deployment - weekly sync notes (2026-08-10)
Owner: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha Patel, Liam Chen (infra), Sofia Martinez (SRE), Carlos Reyes (customer eng), Emily Nguyen (customer)

Agenda:
- Quick status / highlights
- Network / VPC progress
- On-prem hardware & rack install
- Model runtime tests & benchmarks
- Blockers / escalations
- Action items & owners

Notes:
Status: Overall on track for targeted in-region cutover (week of 2026-08-24) but two medium blockers.

Milestones:
- 2026-07-30: Initial design review (done)
- 2026-08-06: VPC peering configured by customer network team (done)
- 2026-08-12: On-prem hardware delivered (ETA from vendor)
- 2026-08-14: Rack install + power/network validation (owner: Liam)
- 2026-08-18: Kernel/driver patch roll (owner: Sofia)
- 2026-08-21: Benchmark run (latency/cold start/throughput) (owner: Aisha)
- 2026-08-24: Canary traffic cutover (owner: Carlos)

Blockers:
1) Vendor delayed shipping manifest for GPU nodes; ETA updated to 2026-08-12 (medium). Customer wants daily updates. Owner for vendor follow-up: Carlos.
2) Network security team flagged MTU mismatch on upstream switch; causing packet drops during large-batch tests. Requires on-site switch config change (high). Owner: Liam. Slack thread: #orion-networking
3) Automated VM image build fails when applying custom KMS hooks in our installer (low). Root cause seems related to credential propagation. Owner: Sofia. Jira: JIRA-PROJ-7821

Discussion / decisions:
- For the vendor delay, agreed to accept partial delivery if >= 2 nodes arrive earlier; Carlos to negotiate.
- MTU issue: temporary workaround to lower batch size until switch config is updated; Sofia to coordinate with on-call network engineer.
- KMS hook failure: will revert to manual image step for this week and file a follow-up bugfix sprint.

Action items:
- Carlos: daily vendor status update, escalate to account manager if no positive update by 2026-08-11. (due 2026-08-11)
- Liam: schedule on-site network engineer for 2026-08-13, confirm switch config change and MTU=9000 validation. (due 2026-08-13)
- Sofia: create branch with debug logs for KMS propagation and attach to JIRA-PROJ-7821, set up test run. (due 2026-08-12)
- Aisha: run pre-cutover benchmark plan and share results in this doc; prepare rollback plan for canary. (due 2026-08-20)
- Emily (customer): confirm maintenance window for 2026-08-24 cutover and resource availability. (due 2026-08-14)

Open questions / risks:
- If vendor later slips beyond 2026-08-12, do we shift canary? Contingency discussed: soft canary with subset of endpoints (reduces capacity). Decision by 2026-08-15.
- KMS integration may delay automated provisioning; impact limited to image build stage but could slow scale tests.

Links:
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/Orion+Deployment+Runbook
- Jira: JIRA-PROJ-7821
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orion-deploy/pull/214

Next sync: 2026-08-17 10:00 PT (weekly cadence) - agenda: vendor update, on-prem install report, benchmark preliminary results.

Notes-to-self: bring test dataset (1000 short prompts) to benchmark run; ask infra to enable packet capture during batch tests for MTU repro.
